steps.player: That good? Everyone around here seems a little depressed.
I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?

steps.npc: It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.

steps.player: How's the King treating you then?

steps.npc: Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.

steps.player: Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.

steps.npc: I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.

steps.player: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.
